description: The line plot illustrates the memory usage (in gigabytes) of five different models—VideoLLaMB-R, PLLaVA, LLaVA-NeXT, and VideoLLAVA—across varying numbers of frames, with the x-axis representing the "Number of Frames" on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1000 in increments of 200, and the y-axis showing "Memory (GB)" on a linear scale from 0 to 400 in increments of 50. The legend identifies the models, with VideoLLaMB-R represented by a gold line with circular markers, PLLaVA by a green line with circular markers, LLaVA-NeXT by a blue line with circular markers, and VideoLLAVA by a purple line with circular markers. The data shows that VideoLLaMB-R and PLLaVA exhibit relatively low and stable memory consumption, increasing from approximately 15 GB to 35 GB and 10 GB to 75 GB, respectively, as the number of frames increases. LLaVA-NeXT shows a moderate increase in memory usage from around 20 GB to 145 GB. In contrast, VideoLLAVA demonstrates a sharp, exponential increase in memory usage, starting at about 25 GB and rising steeply to over 400 GB at 300 frames, after which it continues to climb rapidly. The red line with circular markers and the grey rectangle in the legend are not associated with any plotted data points, indicating they are likely placeholders or represent a non-visual element.
